company.paragraph1: Made in Turkey underwear. Focused on comfort and quality.
company.paragraph2: Founded in 1969, our company has become one of the industry's leading manufacturers and exporters with over half a century of experience, specializing in nightwear, pajama sets, pajama bottoms and underwear.
company.paragraph3: With exports to markets in Eastern Europe and the Middle East — notably the United States, France, Spain, Greece and Israel — we proudly represent our high quality standards and customer-focused approach internationally. Committed to reliability, continuity and quality, our company remains a strong and trusted business partner globally.
